verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, an official OpenAPI 3.1 spec on GitHub, an MCP server and a CLI. None of these is an official SDK or client library. The OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block from which a client could be generated, and the CLI and MCP are separate channels, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
